body.purpose: Working prose and figures; money uses tabular numerals.

label.purpose: Table headers, card section titles, form labels; uppercase, letter-spaced.

shadows.name: primary-button-glow
shadows.purpose: Diffuse glow under the primary accent button in its active state.

shadows.name: dialog-menu
shadows.purpose: Elevated floating lists and dialogs portaled to document.body.

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Elements fade in and rise 14px when scrolled into view.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Dialogs and floating menus scale up from 0.985 and fade in.

motion.name: chart-draw
motion.purpose: Hero chart line draws in resolution-independently via pathLength=1.

motion.name: transition-colors
motion.purpose: Default button and input state transition duration.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation/transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA in mint-emerald with near-black text; hover and active deepen the accent; diffuse glow shadow on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; select-none: none; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding-left: 1rem; padding-right: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; border: none; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: var(--color-mint-emerald-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background-color: var(--color-mint-emerald-active); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subdued action on graphite-surface-muted with a hairline border; hover strengthens the border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding-left: 1rem; padding-right: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background-color: var(--color-surface-muted); color: var(--color-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--color-border-strong); background-color: var(--color-surface); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet action with no background at rest; hover fills surface-muted and shifts text to ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding-left: 1rem; padding-right: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted); background-color: transparent; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: var(--color-surface-muted); color: var(--color-foreground); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action in alert-red-solid with white text; hover deepens the red.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding-left: 1rem; padding-right: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background-color: var(--color-danger-solid); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; border: none; outline: none; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: var(--color-danger-solid-hover); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form control on graphite-surface-muted with a hairline border; focus shifts border to mint-emerald with a subtle focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background-color: var(--color-surface-muted); padding-top: 0.625rem; padding-bottom: 0.625rem; padding-left: 0.875rem; padding-right: 0.875rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-focus-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-focus-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15); outline: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Raised container on graphite-surface with a hairline border and generous internal padding.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background-color: var(--color-surface); padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0; } .ds-card-body { color: var(--color-foreground); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Metric card with subtle lift, an uppercase muted label, and a large tabular value.
components.css: .ds-statcard { border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background-color: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,33,27,0.04); padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-statcard-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; } .ds-statcard-value { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-foreground); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Inline status pill in neutral default or tone variants (ok/warn/danger/accent/gold) with tinted border and subtle fill.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background-color: var(--color-surface-muted); padding-top: 0.125rem; padding-bottom: 0.125rem; padding-left: 0.625rem; padding-right: 0.625rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-badge-accent { border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.25); background-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12); color: var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Currency Chip
components.description: Fully rounded chip mapping a currency to a soft tint so EUR/USD/JPY stay distinct without flag images.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background-color: var(--color-surface-muted); padding-top: 0.125rem; padding-bottom: 0.125rem; padding-left: 0.625rem; padding-right: 0.625rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-chip:selected { background-color: var(--color-surface-muted); color: var(--color-foreground); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Pill-style single-choice switcher; active state fills surface with a subtle shadow.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background-color: var(--color-surface-muted); padding: 0.125rem; } .ds-segment-option { height: 2rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; padding-left: 0.875rem; padding-right: 0.875rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted); background-color: transparent; border: none; outline: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-segment-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-segment-option:hover:not(.ds-segment-option-active) { color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-segment-option-active { background-color: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,33,27,0.08); }

narrative.overview: Calm, precise, and low-pressure. Dark graphite surfaces carry hairline borders and tonal surface variants instead of colour; a single mint-emerald accent is reserved for CTAs, the brand mark, active and positive states, and key converted numbers — never as a decorative wash. Every money figure uses tabular numerals, every interactive control shows a visible focus ring, and all motion collapses to near-still under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Light mode is a 1:1 mirror of the dark ramp, shifted to darker steps so ink keeps WCAG AA on a white surface.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graphite canvas (#0b0c0e) with off-white ink (#f2f4f5)
Single bright accent: mint-emerald (#34d399), used sparingly
Hairline borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.07)) and tonal layering over shadows
Tabular numerals for all money figures
Visible focus rings on every interactive control
Light theme is a value-for-value mirror of the dark ramp

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Mint-emerald is the single bright colour; it appears on primary CTAs, the brand mark, active/positive states, and key converted numbers — never as a decorative wash, glow, shadow, or eyebrow.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Category chips and chart series draw from a six-hue muted palette — never a saturated rainbow, never flag images.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, active, elevation, focus); no ambient coloured glows.

dos: Do use mint-emerald (#34d399) as the single bright accent, on primary CTAs, the brand mark, active/positive states, and key converted numbers only.
Do render all money figures with `tabular-nums` so digits align.
Do show a visible 2px mint-emerald focus ring on every interactive control.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` — collapse all transitions and animations to ~0.01ms.
Do keep category distinctions to the six-hue muted palette; never use flag images or a saturated rainbow.
donts: Don't use mint-emerald as a decorative wash, glow, shadow, or eyebrow — it is reserved for functional emphasis.
Don't introduce a second bright accent hue; secondary and tertiary roles are expressed through tonal graphite, not colour.
Don't use dark-green bank sterility, generic dollar signs, globes with arrows, or bird silhouettes.
Don't add gradients, shadows, or outlines to the orbit mark; use the light/dark SVG variants only.
Don't reassert token hex values in prose; the YAML frontmatter is normative.
